issue.title: Bug: test_counterpoll_watermarkfails to re-enable counterpoll on all ASICs

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Critical

### Description of the bug

The `tests/platform_tests/counterpoll/test_counterpoll_watermark.py` does not correctly enable counterpolling on each asic, it configures the global namespace but counterpoll is an asic-namespace level configuration.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `tests/platform_tests/counterpoll/test_counterpoll_watermark.py` and see
```
Error: Invalid value for '-n' / '--namespace': '' is not one of 'asic0', 'asic1'.
```

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Test expected to enable per-asic and pass.

resolution.title: Fix test_counterpoll_watermark on multi-asic
resolution.description:
Currently the test repeatedly re-enables counterpoll on the global duthost instead of on each asic instance.
This fix is needed for multi-asic systems.

### Description of PR

Summary:
Fixes #23995

### Approach
#### What is the motivation for this PR?
Fix  `tests/platform_tests/counterpoll/test_counterpoll_watermark.py` on multi-asic

#### How did you do it?
Currently the test loops for each asic but incorrectly passes the global duthost instead of the asic duthost to the counterpoll helper.
I fixed this to pass the correct host.

#### How did you verify/test it?
I reran `tests/platform_tests/counterpoll/test_counterpoll_watermark.py` on my multi-asic system and the test ran without error.
